errors.renderDescription: We could not display this screen. Your saved games and local data were not deleted.
errors.roomRecovery: The room screen encountered a problem. Avoid creating another room; return and use the reconnect option.
errors.asyncGeneral: An action failed. Check its result before trying again; your progress has not been deleted.
errors.asyncLan: There was a connection issue. Check the network and resume the room if needed.

guide.title: How to play
guide.intro: Choose how your group wants to play. You can start a game anytime.
guide.sharedDescription: Everyone plays together, sharing a single device.
guide.lanDescription: Each person uses their phone on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot, with no internet required.
guide.groupDescription: Save player names for single-phone games. Saving names does not create a LAN room.

help.title: Multiplayer help
help.intro: Tips for creating, joining, and resuming rooms. Galerows connects directly over your local network.
help.createDescription: In My Group, select Local multiplayer and Create room. The host chooses the game and invites friends.
help.joinDescription: On the same Wi-Fi, open My Group → Local multiplayer → Join room and select an available room.
help.qrDescription: If the room is missing, ask the host for the QR Code or six-digit code. Scan or enter it in the join flow when available.
help.networkDescription: Phones connect directly to the host. Guest networks that isolate devices can block the connection.
help.hotspotDescription: Enable the host phone's hotspot and connect the others to it. Mobile internet isn't required, but everyone must use the same local network.
help.noRoomTitle: If the room does not appear
help.noRoomDescription: Check the same Wi-Fi or hotspot, keep the app open, ensure the room is active, and try the QR Code fallback.
help.reconnectDescription: Keep the host active, reconnect to the same network, and use Resume room or Reconnect. Don't create a second room.
help.leaveDescription: Guests should tap Leave room. The host should close the room when the group is done. Going home alone does not leave the room.
help.connecting: Connecting. Keep devices on the same network and the app in the foreground.
help.connectionError: Unable to connect. Check the network, browse rooms again, or use QR Code/invite.
help.reconnect: Room disconnected. Resume or reconnect; do not create another room.

settings.title: Settings
settings.offlineNote: Your language choice is saved on this device and the app continues to work offline.
settings.connectivity: Single-phone games work offline. For local multiplayer, each participant uses their own phone on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot, with no internet required.
settings.reportProblem: Send feedback or report an issue

privacyNotice.title: Privacy at Galerows
privacyNotice.description: Names, games, and preferences may be stored on this device. In LAN multiplayer, nicknames and game information travel directly between phones on the same network, without Galerows servers. No account or ads are required.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.summary: Galerows requires no account or hosted database. Saved information remains on this device, but LAN participants exchange game information directly between their devices. This version has no ads or subscriptions.
privacy.storedDescription: Player names, groups, active games, scores, favorites, language, and preferences may be saved. The camera scans QR Codes for content and room invites; camera images are neither recorded nor sent to Galerows servers.
privacy.lanTitle: What travels over the local network
privacy.lanDescription: In LAN rooms, the host and participants exchange information needed for play, including nicknames, actions, votes, and scores. Private secrets are intended only for authorized players. Galerows does not relay the game through its own servers.
privacy.deleteDescription: Deletion only affects this device and cannot be undone. Information previously received by other LAN participants is not remotely deleted.
privacy.confirmGameplayDescription: Names, groups, matches, rankings, favorites, and progress will be removed. Language and the privacy notice will be preserved.
privacy.confirmAllDescription: All local Galerows data will be removed, including language and preferences. This action cannot be undone.

updates.availableDescription: A newer version of Galerows is available on the Play Store.
updates.downloadedDescription: Restart the app to install the new version.

premium.heroDescription: Subscribe for {{price}}/month and remove ads from Galerows.
premium.activeDescription: Your subscription is active. Ads stay hidden while premium is valid.

benefits.noAds: No banners, ad cards, or ad screens.

premium.unavailable: Subscriptions are available in the app installed from Google Play or the App Store after RevenueCat is configured.
premium.legal: Premium costs {{price}} per month, renews automatically through the store, and can be canceled in your Google Play or Apple ID account settings. The purchase removes ads; it does not add extra content in this version.
